name: myco
description: Your project's memory: the sessions that happened, the durable observations drawn from them, and the plans. Skills and tools for reading why the code is the way it is, and for recording what you learn.

deployment_url.description: The base URL of your team's Myco deployment, for example https://myco.example.com

access_key.description: A project access key from your deployment dashboard. It reaches one project and expires.
